name: Diagnostic Self-Calibration

protocol.referenceModel: biased aggregate observation y = true R + b_i + e_i; reference z = gain*b_i + e_ref - lag*step(b)
protocol.qualificationRule: Only simulation-reference configurations with declared known unit gain and zero lag may influence hypothetical recovery. Other configurations force abstention even if classified.

limitations: Reference signal uses the same simulated bias generator; independence from the target physical process is assumed and unverified.
Training and holdout use same functional noise generator; held-out phases and drift magnitudes do not establish distributional independence.
Noisy reference gain mismatch causes one false accepted classification. Withheld metadata prevents its promotion but does not empirically verify reference gain.
No-pulse calibration can also classify all nominal cases; active pulse incremental benefit is small and condition dependent.
The reported permission is an internal classification gate, not restoration of three independent witness roots.
No real sensor actuation, physical energy, nuclear fusion, spinors or fundamental-force validation.
